title: Residents & parties
description: People and companies on your leases — residents, co-residents, occupants and guarantors.
newBody: The ID number is stored sealed; only Owners and Managers can see it, with a recorded purpose.

empty.title: No residents yet
empty.body: Add a resident here or while creating a lease.

form.phoneHint: Used for the lease signing code and SMS invitations
form.languageHint: For messages, bills and the lease

detail.linksHint: Logins linked to this party through an invitation or a match.
detail.documentsHint: Each opening is recorded with its purpose.
detail.linkRequestsHint: A login that signed in with this party's phone sees its data only after the Owner confirms.

privacy.title: Show sealed personal data
privacy.body: The purpose is recorded in the audit log with your name.
privacy.purposeHint: For example: checking the lease before signing
privacy.documentBody: Opening the document is recorded with its purpose.

links.none: No logins linked yet. Invite the resident from their lease.
links.unlinkBody: The person can no longer see this party's bills and lease in the resident app.

linkRequests.title: Link requests
linkRequests.description: Someone signed in to the resident app with the SMS code of a phone number you entered. They see no lease, bill or door code of that party until the Owner confirms it is the same person.
linkRequests.howBody: Call the number on file or ask the resident whether they just signed in. If not, reject it with a reason. Invitation codes (QR / link) still link at once.
linkRequests.ownerOnly: Only the Owner confirms or rejects these requests.

empty.title: No link requests waiting
empty.body: When someone signs in with a phone that matches a party, the request waits here.

linkRequests.confirmBody: Links the login “{login}” to {party}: from its next refresh it sees {party}'s leases, bills and door codes.
linkRequests.rejectBody: The login “{login}” is not linked to {party}.
linkRequests.alreadyDecided: Someone already decided this request; the list is up to date.
